No fault · AUTO ≥ {normalModeMin} · at limit ≤ {saturationMax} · good-error share ≥ floor (G3) · effort not strong (G4)

The headline of control-loop monitoring: loops judged with no fault, on qualified data, in their normal mode, not at an OP limit, with the good-error share at or above the profile floor (G3) and no strong actuator activity (G4).
